# Command reference

<!-- Generated by `node tools/specfold/docs.mjs` from the CLI's --help output; do not edit. -->

Run every command from the repository root as `node scripts/specfold.mjs <command>`. `<command> --help` prints its usage line. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 findings, 2 usage or environment error. Most commands take `--json` for machine-readable output.

## agents

Link .agents/skills into the skill folders of agent tools.

```sh
specfold agents sync [--check] [--json]
```

## audit

Report stale, unverified, deprecated-linked and orphaned concepts, specs without a card, overdue commitments and old backlog items.

```sh
specfold audit [--json]
```

## backlog

Add, list, promote and drop backlog items.

```sh
specfold backlog add <title> [--priority <p>] [--origin <text>] [--description <text>] | list [--state <state>] | promote <item> [--name <change>] | drop <item> --reason <text>  [--json]
```

## change

Check a change's brief.md, knowledge.md and tasks.md.

```sh
specfold change check <change> [--json]
```

## commitments

List, fulfill and withdraw deferred commitments (withdraw: humans only).

```sh
specfold commitments list [--state <state>] | fulfill <commitment> --change <name> | withdraw <commitment> --reason <text>  [--json]
```

## doctor

Check the environment and Specfold configuration.

```sh
specfold doctor [--json]
```

## drift

Find concepts whose code or sources changed after they were last written or verified.

```sh
specfold drift [<path>...] [--json]
```

## gate

Decide whether a branch may merge: run the merge-gate rules on its diff; require makes it a required check.

```sh
specfold gate --base <ref> [--local] [--pr <number>] [--label <name>]... [--pr-body <file>] [--summary <file>] [--json] | require [--dry-run] [--json]
```

## graphify

Set up graphify code-only: its skill, .graphifyignore, the Claude Code guard and the first graph.

```sh
specfold graphify setup [--json]
```

## hook

Run one hook: Specfold's checks for it, then hooks.extra (called by the installed hooks).

```sh
specfold hook <name> [args...]
```

## hooks

Install Specfold's git hooks, or add them to the repository's hook manager.

```sh
specfold hooks install [--json]
```

## index

Generate every index.md of the knowledge bundle.

```sh
specfold index [--check] [--bundle <dir>] [--json]
```

## init

Finish setting up a repository made from the template: settings, OpenSpec skills, links, hooks.

```sh
specfold init [--stack <text>] [--source-glob <glob>]... [--tools <list>] [--max-subagents <n>] [--upgrade-workflow] [--require-gate] [--dry-run] [--json]
```

## log

Add a dated entry to the bundle's log.md.

```sh
specfold log add [--kind <Kind>] [--date <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--bundle <dir>] <message...>
```

## lookup

Find concepts by their frontmatter.

```sh
specfold lookup <query...> [--type <type>] [--limit <n>] [--bundle <dir>] [--json]
```

## migrate

Bring an existing repository into Specfold: own branch, state, inventory, kit install.

```sh
specfold migrate start [--default-branch <name>] | inventory | install --from <dir> [--tools <list>] [--stack <text>] [--source-glob <glob>]... [--ref <ref>] [--upgrade-workflow] | mark <step> | status  [--json]
```

## new

Create a concept from its type's template.

```sh
specfold new <type> <path> [--title <text>] [--description <text>] [--by <actor>] [--json]
```

## parallel

Set or show your personal limit on subagents running at the same time.

```sh
specfold parallel set <n> | show [--json]
```

## resume

Print the next open task with its group context.

```sh
specfold resume <change> [--json]
```

## stats

Estimate the tokens an agent always loads, against the budgets in specfold.yaml.

```sh
specfold stats [<path>...] [--json]
```

## status

Show task progress per group and the next open task.

```sh
specfold status [<change>] [--json]
```

## sync

Apply an archived change's knowledge delta: stubs, keys, indexes, log.

```sh
specfold sync <change> [--dry-run] [--json]
```

## tasks

Check a change's task breakdown.

```sh
specfold tasks check <change> [--base <ref>] | packet <change> <group>  [--json]
```

## trace

Map spec scenarios to the tests that reference them; report uncovered and dangling ones.

```sh
specfold trace [--change <name>] [--json]
```

## upgrade

Upgrade the installed kit to a newer release: check, plan, or apply on its own branch.

```sh
specfold upgrade [--check] [--to <version>] [--yes] [--pr] [--json]
```

## validate

Check a knowledge bundle: OKF conformance, profile rules, links.

```sh
specfold validate [<path>...] [--bundle <dir>] [--okf-only] [--json]
```

## verify

Mark concepts as verified by you (humans only).

```sh
specfold verify <path>... [--json]
```

## wt

Plan, create, set up and clean worktrees for parallel changes and task groups.

```sh
specfold wt plan | new <change> | setup | clean [--base <ref>] [--json]
```
